svg.text: UR Subnet — Mechanism at a glance (settlement v2)

From E_s the pool tier is paid by verified usage into cumulative, never-expiring coldkey accounts: one Merkle sum-tree root per pool each epoch, approved by auditors and final after a 14,400-block challenge window. §1, §6, §8.2–8.5.

Providers — the pool tier (TAIL, ≥ 1M per pool by design)
carry traffic inside a NO's pool — no UID, no registration burn.
paid in proportion to verified usage only: no reliability factor,

paid only under a signed payout consent (own, network's, delegation);
claim anytime: the apps / SDK, snclaim, or the claim daemon.
no timing promise: a claim costs ≈ 0.19 α of gas at 5 gwei.

— epoch = 50,400 blocks (≈ 7 days); E_s = the first epoch starting at least two days after the last activation gate (SN25 plan: epoch 3, ≈ 2026-10-23) · missed close -> later earners; missed root -> next root

pool = verified-usage share, cumulative per coldkey · head = routable-IP breadth, native · SN25 treasury row 1 − μ = 9/10 to ur-reserve

vault2 is immutable: accrued balances survive a bad STSettlement2 upgrade or a compromised root signer and auditor, as long as each fault is challenged or its account demanded within the window (VERSION2-FINAL §4.2)
